sqlite.ddl:
CREATE TABLE demo_environment (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	version INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE users (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	telegram_id INTEGER, 
	username VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	telegram_username VARCHAR(64), 
	display_name VARCHAR(128), 
	photo_url VARCHAR(1024), 
	balance FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	balance_nano BIGINT, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CHECK (balance_nano IS NOT NULL AND balance_nano BETWEEN 0 AND 9223372036854775807), 
	UNIQUE (telegram_id), 
	UNIQUE (username)
)

CREATE TABLE chat_read_states (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	scope_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	last_read_message_id INTEGER DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_chat_read_scope UNIQUE (user_id, scope_key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE demo_guarantor_actors (
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	strategy VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (user_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	UNIQUE (strategy)
)

CREATE TABLE guarantor_profiles (
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	bio VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL, 
	topics VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL, 
	available_until DATETIME, 
	last_seen_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (user_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE markets (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	question VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT NOT NULL, 
	creator_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	category VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'unique' NOT NULL, 
	mechanism VARCHAR(16) DEFAULT 'lmsr' NOT NULL, 
	b FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	q_yes FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	q_no FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	outcomes JSON NOT NULL, 
	q JSON NOT NULL, 
	lock_ton FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	pot FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	pot_nano BIGINT, 
	lock_nano BIGINT, 
	close_at DATETIME, 
	lock_returned BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(9) NOT NULL, 
	winning_outcome VARCHAR(128), 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	resolved_at DATETIME, 
	rejection_reason VARCHAR(1000), 
	moderated_at DATETIME, 
	moderated_by INTEGER, 
	cancellation_reason VARCHAR(1000), 
	cancelled_at DATETIME, 
	cancelled_by INTEGER, 
	settlement_kind VARCHAR(16), 
	visibility VARCHAR(16) DEFAULT 'public' NOT NULL, 
	share_token VARCHAR(64), 
	p2p_journal_coverage VARCHAR(16) DEFAULT 'not_applicable' NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CHECK (pot_nano IS NOT NULL AND pot_nano BETWEEN 0 AND 9223372036854775807), 
	CHECK (lock_nano IS NOT NULL AND lock_nano BETWEEN 0 AND 9223372036854775807), 
	FOREIGN KEY(creator_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	UNIQUE (share_token)
)

CREATE TABLE app_notifications (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	market_id INTEGER, 
	text VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL, 
	read BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(market_id) REFERENCES markets (id)
)

CREATE TABLE chat_messages (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	market_id INTEGER, 
	text TEXT NOT NULL, 
	reply_to_id INTEGER, 
	attached_market_id INTEGER, 
	deleted_at DATETIME, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(market_id) REFERENCES markets (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(reply_to_id) REFERENCES chat_messages (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	FOREIGN KEY(attached_market_id) REFERENCES markets (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)

CREATE TABLE demo_guarantor_runs (
	market_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	actor_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	scenario VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	next_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	progress JSON NOT NULL, 
	last_error VARCHAR(300), 
	PRIMARY KEY (market_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(market_id) REFERENCES markets (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_id) REFERENCES demo_guarantor_actors (user_id)
)

CREATE TABLE event_config_v3 (
	market_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	event_type VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	ends_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	terms JSON NOT NULL, 
	moderator_edited BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	reward JSON NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (market_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(market_id) REFERENCES markets (id)
)

CREATE TABLE event_revisions_v3 (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	market_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	actor_id INTEGER, 
	kind VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	snapshot JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(market_id) REFERENCES markets (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(actor_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE guarantor_cases (
	market_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	guarantor_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	creator_confirmed INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	criteria TEXT NOT NULL, 
	source TEXT NOT NULL, 
	result_due_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	deadline DATETIME, 
	extension_by INTEGER, 
	proposed_outcome INTEGER, 
	decision_reason TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (market_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(market_id) REFERENCES markets (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(guarantor_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE guarantor_messages (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	market_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	text TEXT NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(market_id) REFERENCES markets (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE guarantor_reviews (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	market_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	guarantor_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	rating INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	text VARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (market_id, user_id), 
	CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5), 
	FOREIGN KEY(market_id) REFERENCES markets (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(guarantor_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE p2p_orders (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	market_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	request_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	outcome INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	price INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	amount BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	remaining BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	filled BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	refunded BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (user_id, request_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(market_id) REFERENCES markets (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE positions (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	market_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	shares_yes FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	shares_no FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	cost_yes FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	cost_no FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	shares JSON NOT NULL, 
	costs JSON NOT NULL, 
	claimed BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	tip_paid FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (user_id, market_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(market_id) REFERENCES markets (id)
)

CREATE TABLE private_terms_consents (
	market_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (market_id, user_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(market_id) REFERENCES markets (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE settlement_records (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	market_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	question VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, 
	winning_outcome VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	chosen_outcomes JSON NOT NULL, 
	stakes_total FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	payout FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	tip FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	credited FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	result FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	lock_ton FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	residual_returned FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	resolved_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (market_id, user_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(market_id) REFERENCES markets (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE trades (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	market_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	outcome VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	money FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	shares FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	price_after FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(market_id) REFERENCES markets (id)
)

CREATE TABLE p2p_fills (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	market_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	maker_order_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	taker_order_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	maker_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	taker_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	maker_outcome INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	maker_stake BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	taker_stake BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	price INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(market_id) REFERENCES markets (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(maker_order_id) REFERENCES p2p_orders (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(taker_order_id) REFERENCES p2p_orders (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(maker_user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(taker_user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE p2p_money_entries (
	id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	entry_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	op_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	market_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	order_id INTEGER, 
	fill_id INTEGER, 
	from_kind VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	from_user_id INTEGER, 
	from_order_id INTEGER, 
	to_kind VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	to_user_id INTEGER, 
	to_order_id INTEGER, 
	amount BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	origin_key VARCHAR(128), 
	reason VARCHAR(32), 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_p2p_money_entry_key UNIQUE (entry_key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(market_id) REFERENCES markets (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(order_id) REFERENCES p2p_orders (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(fill_id) REFERENCES p2p_fills (id)
)
